WqgH0fc6E59X80_IFJEN4Q.zh: 美國報告1起郵輪群聚事件,截至5/11累計報告160例病例,占全體乘客及工作人員的3.6%,符合侵襲率超過3%需通報的規範,並確認致病原為諾羅病毒。該船4/28自佛羅里達州啟航,預計經過巴哈馬後前往佛羅里達州。另美國近年研究顯示GII.17型病毒的盛行,可能導致多數乘客於欠缺免疫防護下感染病毒。
WqgH0fc6E59X80_IFJEN4Q.en: The United States reported one cruise-ship cluster, with 160 cases cumulatively as of 11 May, equal to 3.6% of all passengers and crew. This meets the reporting criterion of an attack rate above 3%, and norovirus was confirmed as the pathogen. The ship departed from Florida on 28 April and is expected to call at the Bahamas before returning to Florida. Recent US studies show circulation of GII.17 virus, which may lead to most passengers becoming infected without immune protection.
